paite: Huan, Joseph a kianga ding te ma ah a kidekzou takei a, mi tengteng ka kianga kipan pawt khe sak vek un, chiin, a kikou a. Huchiin, Joseph a unaute kianga a kigen sung teng a kiangah kuamah a ding kei uh.
english: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he cried, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

paite: Huan, a kap loloih a, huchiin, Aigupta ten a ja ua, Pharo inkuanpih ten leng a ja uhi.
english: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.

paite: Huan, Joseph in a unaute kiangah, Joseph ka hi; kapa a damlai na maw? Achia. Ahihhangin a unauten a dawng theikei ua, a maah buaitakin a omta uhi.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.

paite: Huan, Joseph, mahin, a unaute kiangah, hehpihtakin honnaih un, achia. Huchiin a vanaih ua. Huan, aman, na unaupa uh Joseph, Aigupta gam a lutpih dinga na khot uh ka hi.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. “He said, I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

paite: Ahihhangin hiailaia pai dinga non khot jiakun lungkham kei unla, ki hehkhum tuan kei un: mite hinna hondam dingin Pathianin na ma ua hinna sawl masa ahi.
english: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.

paite: Hiai kum nih sungin hiai gamah kial a hongketa a: kum nga in a sam laia, huai sungin leileh a om kei ding, buhlak leng a om sam kei ding.
english: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be neither plowing nor harvest.

paite: Huchiin, lei a suante nou honhawi sak ding leh, hotdamna thupi taka hingdam a ka hon omsak na dingin Pathianin na ma uah a honsawl masa ahi.
english: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.

paite: Huchiin, hiai a honsawl nou na hijaw kei ua, Pathian ahi jaw hi: aman Pharo pain leh a inkuanpihte tengteng heutu in leh Aigupta gam tengteng vaihawm tu in a honbawlta a.
english: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

paite: Kintakin ka pa kiangah vahoh unla, a kiangah, na tapa Joseph in hichiin achia, Pathian in Aigupta gam tengteng heutuin a honbawl ta: ka kiangah hongpai sukin, sawt honhal ken:
english: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.

paite: Huchiin, Gosen gamah na om dinga, ka kiang ngeiah na om ding, nang leh, na tate leh, na tute leh, na belam honte leh, na bawng honte leh, na neih tengteng toh.
english: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.

paite: Huailaiah keiman ka honvak ding; kial na ding lah kum nga a omlai ngala; huchilouin jaw na genthei kha ding, nang leh, na inkuanpihte leh, na neih tengteng toh, honchi un.
english: There I will nourish you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’

paite: Huan, ngai un, noumau mit ngei leh ka nau Benjamin mit ngeiin keimah kam mahmah in a genlai na mu kilkel uhi.
english: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.

paite: Huan, Aigupta gama ka thupina tengteng thu leh, na thil muh tengteng thu uh kapa na hilh ding ua; kapa kintakin hiailaiah non pi suk pah ding uh ahi, achia.
english: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”

paite: Huan, a nau Benjamin ngawnga kunin a kapta a; Benjamin a ngawng kunin a kapta.
english: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.

paite: Huan, a unaute tengteng a tawpa, a kah khum chiata: huai khitin a unauten thuvantang a genpih uhi.
english: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.

paite: Huan, Joseph unaute a hong uh chih thu thuthang Pharo inn ah ana zata ua: huaiin Pharo leh a sikhate a kipak sak mahmah.
english: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

paite: Huan, Pharoin, Joseph kiangah, na unaute kiangah, hichiin hih un; na sate uh buh posak unla, pawt unla, Kanan gamah pai un;
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this. Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.

paite: Huan, napa uh leh, na inkuanpihte uh pi unla, ka kiangah hongpai un; huchiin, Aigupta gam a thil hoihte ka honpe dinga, hiai gam a thil om hoih pente na ne ding uh, chiin.
english: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’

paite: Thu ka honpia hi, hichi ahi, hichiin hih un; nata neu chikchik te uh ding leh na jite uh ding Aigupta gam akipan in kangtalai te la unla, na pa uh pi dingin va kuan un.
english: Now you are commanded: do this. Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

paite: Na van uh leng ngaihtuah nuam dah un, Aigupta gam tengteng thil hoih peuhmah lah nou a ahi ngala, achia.
english: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all of the land of Egypt is yours.”

paite: Huchiin Israel taten huchibangin a hih ua: huan, Joseph in Pharo thupiak bang in kangtalai te a kianguah a pia a, lampi a dingin nek ding leng a pia hi.
english: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

paite: A vek ua kiangah puansilh kikhenna ding a pe chiat a; Benjamin kianga ngialah houh dangka za thum leh puansilh kikhenna ding nga a pia a.
english: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.

paite: Huan, a pa kiangah hichibang a khak a: Aigupta gam a thil hoih pua sabengtung sawm leh lampi a apa a ding buh leh tanghou leh nek ding pua sabengtung nu sawm a khak hi.
english: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.

paite: Huchiin a unaute a sawlkhia a, a paita ua; huan, aman a kianguah, lampia kinalou dingin pilvang un, achi hi.
english: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”

paite: Huan, Aigupta gam akipan a pai tou ua, Kanan gama apa Jakob kiang a vatung ua.
english: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

paite: Huan, a kiangah, Joseph a hinglaia, Aigupta gam tengteng heutu ahi, chiin, a hilh ua. Huan, a thugen uh a gintak louh jiakin, a lungtang a bahta.
english: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.

paite: Huan, a kiang ua Joseph thugen tengteng a hilh ua; huan, a tuanna ding kangtalai Joseph in a khakte a muh in Jakob lungtang a halh nawn hi:Huan, Israel in a hunta; ka tapa Joseph hingdama na om ei ngut ve: ka sih ma in amah ka vamu ding, achi hi.
english: They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob, their father, revived.

paite: Huan, Israel in a hunta; ka tapa Joseph hingdama na om ei ngut ve: ka sih ma in amah ka vamu ding, achi hi.
english: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”
